rows.label: Mother Token
rows.note: a T5 pays a bit over 100
rows.alt: Grandmother's Mend the Family trade, or tokens found in the Drift

conditions: Do the bonus objective on every stage; clearing all of them adds an end roll.
bonuses: Tokens never expire, so bank them any time of year and show up to Naberus ready.
Objectives scale with squad size but rewards don't, so solo is faster if you can handle it.

disclosures.title: the endless bounty
disclosures.body: Mother's bounty marked (Endless) runs 3 stages per cycle with rising level and payout; one player got 250-275 tokens over 4 cycles. It suits a newer player, but standard T5 Brute Force pays better per hour and a crash loses the streak. Skip Steel Path bounties unless geared; some Deimos Infested have harsh damage attenuation above level 60.

live.text: sold only during Nights of Naberus

conditions: Nobody else sells it; out of season the only source is trading with another player, and missing the window means waiting a year.

disclosures.title: ended sources
disclosures.body: Scarlet Spear, Orphix Venom, Gargoyle's Cry, Belly of the Beast, Eight Claw and Blood of Perita all sold it once and have ended.

groups.activity: Railjack; sweep asteroids, red barrels and wreckage after the objective
conditions: Isos only drops in Corpus Proxima (Venus, Neptune, Pluto); Earth Proxima is Grineer and has none.
bonuses: Shatterburst breaks asteroids and scrap in a wide area.
A resource booster helps; defense and survival Proxima nodes are good resource farms.
